create_classifier_reranker_agent: create a ClassifierRerankerAgent that re-ranks candidate outputs using a classifier model file
batch_classify_candidates: use batch_classify to predict augmented context with response candidates through the predictor
configure_target_label: configure the ClassifierReranker target label to maximize probability of a specific class

add_classifier_reranker_args: add command line arguments for include_label_cand_only and target_label to the parser
